validation: Two real deadlock cycles confirmed: Product<->SaleItem (consumptionDays propagation vs forecast read + TASK-08 stock reconciliation) and Sale<->SaleItem (soldAt propagation vs forecast read + TASK-07 has-items guard). Neither fixable by reordering row locks. Fix 20260819140000_serialize_forecast_lock_order takes one transaction-scoped advisory lock in a statement-level BEFORE trigger - shared for SaleItem writes, exclusive for the two propagating parent statements, armed only by UPDATE OF the propagating column so TASK-08/TASK-07 inner updates never upgrade shared->exclusive. A plain global mutex was tried first and rejected: it removed the deadlocks but serialized whole transactions and hung the TASK-07 barrier case. New harness scripts/sale-forecast-lock-order-check.mjs reproduces both cycles pre-fix and requires both to commit post-fix. The review's suggested FOR KEY SHARE was implemented and empirically rejected: a soldAt correction is a non-key update, KEY SHARE does not conflict with it, and the stale snapshot was still served. Shipped fix 20260819180000_order_sale_locks_for_forecast uses FOR NO KEY UPDATE with a fixed lock order (a move locks both sale rows, lowest id first), which rejects the stale writer with 40001 while keeping the round-4 cross-sale cycle closed. Trigger never fires on DELETE so TASK-07 concurrent removals are untouched.
